about_the_game:
Type !play in chat to join! Fyte is a Twitch-Integrated game made for streamers and their viewers. Up to 500 viewers can !play and !attack each other while their bot-controlled avatars battle it out across multiple maps and game modes.

  • Last Viewer Standing: MANY WILL !PLAY. ONLY ONE SHALL !WIN.

  • Deathmatch: Fight to the this match.

  • Team Deathmatch: Red vs Blue for all the marbles.

  • King of the Hill: HOLD THE LINE! Well, the hill. You get the point.

  • Capitalism RULE$: The Fyte Twitch Extension lets YOU make $$$MONEY$$$...Possibly...Allow Viewers to use Twitch Bits for Air Strikes to obliterate other viewers, revive themselves after being abducted by aliens, and more! Set the prices high, low, or however you feel. Enable the events you like, disable the ones you don't. Set cooldowns or don't! It's your stream, you can do what you like! There are no rules but the ones you make!

  • Boost Viewer Engagement: Viewers can !play, !attack <username>, and !vote for maps directly from chat or using the Fyte Twitch Extension. Hell, they can even talk smack if they win or lose. That's up to them though. We're not responsible for their actions. You might want to have some moderators around. Streamer discretion is advised.

  • Leaderboards: Viewers can play and possibly be rewarded with their name at the top of the Global or Per-Channel Leaderboards. In-game leaderboards feature both channel and global results, while the Twitch Extension Leaderboards highlights your channel’s top Fyters.

content_descriptors.notes: The bots pew pew each other with guns and blood comes out. Sometimes they get blown up and lose limbs. It's goofy looking and cartoony at best.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet recommended for best Twitch interaction experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet recommended for best Twitch interaction experience
